name: Evaluated Under Standard
description: A Security Hub control finding is evaluated under a standard enabled on its hub (finding -> standards subscription): each Compliance.AssociatedStandards[].StandardsId matched against the resource portion of an enabled standard's StandardsArn from the same hub's GetEnabledStandards. A reference, not containment; a StandardsId no enabled standard names has no edge. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
